szoveg_eredeti:
We've decided to keep Perplexity Decider-v1.3 (and Flash) free for another 3 weeks on @OpenRouter.  Perplexity's share of requests on Decision models is now close to 20%. We're able to do this because we own the full stack: model, inference, compute, search. Have fun!

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Perplexity Developers (@perplexitydevs); megjelent: 2026-11-12T18:33:50+00:00; link: https://x.com/perplexitydevs/status/2120948200232419356; média: videó, 16 másodperc]
We're rolling out pplx-decider-v1.3 and pplx-decider-flash-v1.3, the latest version of our open-weight decision models.

v1.3 adds locate, a new feature that extracts spans based on type or instructions.

Now available in our Decisions API, @huggingface, and @OpenRouter.

https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/perplexity-decider
